calculation.description: Twenty-trading-day momentum weighted by the ten-day directional efficiency ratio. Positive values reward persistent directional movement and attenuate choppy momentum; negative values identify persistent declines. Cross-sectional ranking is used for portfolio applications.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.036841), 2023-2024 (+0.028612), and 2025-2027 (+0.016607). Five-day and ten-day IC were also positive (+0.064186 and +0.068213), supporting decay beyond one day, while admission uses the daily horizon.
